title: Revamp: Archive & repo reorg
note: Archival of large exports and reorganization of scattered files into revamp/archive + scripts/ + tools/tests. Backup manifest created (revamp/archive/20251113/backup_manifest.json).

subtasks.title: Apply archive moves (git mv) and commit

title: Infrastructure & DB verification
note: Verify pgvector, vector dim, HNSW index and chunk_tsv, migrated embedding_vector typed column, and confirmed missing_vectors=0.

title: Tasks Manager & UI polish
note: Streamlit Tasks Manager: All / Completed / Next tabs, modified_at metadata, confirmation before auto-mark, CSV export and sprint banner.

title: Repo hygiene & tooling
note: Pre-commit, detect-secrets, prepare_archive.py, apply_archive.py, db_sanity.py. Addressed pre-commit issues (EOF, whitespace, secrets false positives).

title: ANN evaluation endpoint + UI (Priority A1)
note: Server-side ANN evaluation endpoint and a Streamlit admin button to run ANN recall/latency evaluations and store results for analysis.

subtasks.title: Define ann_jobs table or reuse ingest_jobs for job tracking
Add POST /admin/ann_eval to retrieval_api (accepts params: model, num_queries, top_k, ef_search)
Run eval_ann.py server-side as background job (store results .json)
Streamlit UI button to trigger job & show progress + result link
Save evaluation result to tools/ or data/ for audit

title: Reranker integration (Priority A2)
note: Add cross-encoder reranker as final scoring stage for union candidates. Provide config toggle and batch rerank.

subtasks.title: Add config to MCP to optionally call reranker
Add reranker model caching & batch scoring
Evaluate reranker recall improvements on ground truth

title: Title-chunk & targeted re-embed (Priority A3)
note: Quick fix for low-recall docs (e.g., q47): create a short title/summary chunk for failing docs and re-embed with stronger model if necessary.

subtasks.title: Re-embed failing doc chunks with stronger model (intfloat/e5)
Run hybrid eval q47 and report improvements

title: Confluence subtree ingestion by URL (Priority B1)
note: Accept a Confluence page URL in the UI, translate to page_id, collect descendants via CQL ancestor=PAGE_ID, preview and ingest selected pages.

subtasks.title: Add new Streamlit UI flow: Collect Preview -> Select -> Ingest subtree

title: Async ingestion workers (Priority B2)
note: Add background worker with Redis/RQ or Celery to handle large ingests asynchronously with job tracking, retries and status.

subtasks.title: Add ingest_jobs table + job runner scaffolding

title: Connectors: Google Drive & Teams (Priority B3)
note: Add connectors and ingestion flows when credentials/permissions are available.

subtasks.title: Add Drive connector with oauth flow & preview
Add connector test & status in UI

title: MCP enforcement, multi-model & logging (Priority C1)
note: Finalise Model Context Protocol (MCP) rules, multi-model routing and detailed logging for auditability.

subtasks.title: EmbedAdapter: finalize model routing (docs vs code)

title: Near-duplicate detection & canonicalization (Priority C2)
note: Prevent redundant ingestion of highly similar docs (SimHash/MinHash or high-sim embedding thresholds).

subtasks.title: Integrate into ingest flow to skip near-duplicates
Add UI to view grouped duplicates

title: Monitoring, CI & production hardening (Priority C3)
note: Add metrics (Prometheus), tests, CI jobs, and a production checklist (backup, pgbouncer, scaling notes).

subtasks.title: Add unit tests for core modules
Expose basic Prometheus metrics (ingest rate, queries/sec)
Add CI workflow and PR checks

title: Side: UI polish & task UX
note: AgGrid UX polishing, modal JSON viewer, side-task tracking improvements, and better Task Manager visuals.

subtasks.title: AgGrid color coding and inline JSON viewer
Make completed tasks look like Next tasks (same UX)
Add small confirmation prompt before auto-marking (already implemented)
